statusForOpening now tracks photo-selection identity separately from status-check generation. After captured read drains, a replacement same-photo generation is awaited instead of failing on nil snapshot. Does not launch an extra read merely to follow replacement. Task cancellation checked; photo changes cancel the old opener even on away/back to identical image ID. Batch admission and native error behavior preserved. No timer/poll/native fallback.

Two-gated-read regression explicitly observes first captured-await, requests same-photo refresh, releases old read, holds replacement read and checks opener has followed without finishing; then returns exact replacement snapshot and asserts exactly two calls. Separate away/back negative control requires CancellationError and preserves current selection. Internal nonescaping wait observer is a deterministic test seam; production no-op. Test timeouts are failure deadlines only.
